source_evidence.location: Artwork Details and full Overview; first/only paragraph, Salon 1869, Gautier response and later landscape revisions
source_evidence.finding: Met Overview says the painter exhibited the work at Salon 1869, rare among his publicly exhibited figure studies; Théophile Gautier praised color and naïveté but found the female figure drawing faulty. The artist later repainted the landscape while retaining the figure. Exact quotes bound to three Japanese claims.
